description:
Every signed action. No action: the index of actions, their args and
    effects. action = 'subject.verb'; its fields go in `args` (with
    `args.wallet`), `signature` top-level. Sign the playauth text locally
    (GET /api/play/message); keys never touch this server. Score-blind: no
    meter number gates or moves a payout. Read the board with `munus` first.
name: play
